summary: Summit Therapeutics filed an 8-K noting that its audit committee and independent directors approved company affiliates to purchase shares under an existing at-the-market offering with J.P. Morgan. Separately, CEO Robert Duggan, Co-CEO Mahkam Zanganeh, and COO/CFO Manmeet Soni indicated they are likely to buy shares at prevailing market prices, but made no binding commitments or specified amounts. This is a routine disclosure of potential insider purchases under a pre-existing ATM program, not a standalone special situation event. No deal terms or structural changes are announced; no recommendation or advisor is named. What to watch: any actual filings of insider purchases under Section 16, but the filing itself triggers no risk-arb angle.
